releaseNotes:
• Fixed Bangla Voice Model Routing: Switching Announcement Language to Bangla now properly binds your selected Piper Female/Male voice model and distinct pitch/speed calibration instead of falling back to the legacy default bn-BD voice
• Added Official Bangla Piper Model (bn_BD-google-medium): Multi-speaker 16-voice Bengali neural model added to Piper Voice Catalog, Gender Picker, and Starter Pack
• Live Settings Voice Sync: Settings hub badge and Voice Test Studio now display the active bound voice profile and selected model in real time
